tables.name: baseline_price
tables.comment: Baseline price and transport price per product group, corridor and month, as loaded from market data.

columns.comment: Origin-destination corridor code (for example VLD-NRL).
columns.name: corridor

columns.comment: Timestamp of the market data snapshot the row comes from.
columns.name: as_of

tables.name: client_profile
tables.comment: A client of the platform: master data merged from the client registry, one row per external reference.

columns.comment: Identifier of the client in the client registry (CR-nnnn).
columns.name: external_ref

columns.comment: Three-letter country code of the client seat.
columns.name: country

columns.comment: Commercial segment used for peer simulation (SMALL, MID, LARGE).
columns.name: segment

tables.name: client_role
tables.comment: Role of a client per product group (IMPORTER, EXPORTER, MIXED, UNDETERMINED) as decided from its movements or overridden in a session.

columns.comment: How the role was decided: MOVEMENTS (computed) or SESSION (override by the representative).
columns.name: source

columns.comment: Free-text justification of a session override; empty for computed roles.
columns.name: reason

tables.name: cover_policy
tables.comment: Cover policies of a client per product group and sub-product: covered share, premium rate, validity.

columns.comment: Share of the value covered by the policy (0 to 1).
columns.name: covered_share

columns.comment: Premium as a rate of the covered value.
columns.name: premium_rate

tables.name: cover_quote
tables.comment: Quote requested from the cover provider for the uncovered value of a session.

columns.comment: Reference of the quote at the cover provider; null while the request is pending.
columns.name: provider_ref

tables.name: goods_movement
tables.comment: Daily movements as imported from the file exchange, one row per line of the file after validation.

columns.comment: Transport mode of the movement (Product 2 dimension); null for Product 1.
columns.name: transport_mode

columns.comment: IN (import) or OUT (export) from the point of view of the client.
columns.name: direction

columns.comment: Port the unit price refers to.
columns.name: price_basis

tables.name: import_batch
tables.comment: One received movement file: its status and row counts.

columns.comment: Rows the validator refused (unknown client, bad period, negative quantity).
columns.name: rows_rejected

tables.name: market_scenario
tables.comment: Market scenario defined in a session: named shocks on prices and transport prices used by the stress test.

columns.comment: PRESET (from the catalogue) or CUSTOM (edited in the session).
columns.name: kind

columns.comment: JSON list of shocks: target (price, transport), period range, relative change.
columns.name: shocks

tables.name: meeting_report
tables.comment: The meeting report of a closed session: payload sent for rendering, PDF path and rendering status.

columns.comment: REQUESTED, RENDERED or FAILED.
columns.name: status

tables.name: meeting_session
tables.comment: A meeting with a client (CLIENT) or a preparation dry run (PREPARATION) for one product group; every session-scoped table hangs off it.

columns.comment: CLIENT: with the client present; PREPARATION: rehearsal by the representative, never reported.
columns.name: kind

columns.comment: OPEN while inputs can change; CLOSED freezes the session and triggers the report.
columns.name: status

columns.comment: Client role chosen in the session instead of the computed one; null = computed role applies.
columns.name: role_override

columns.comment: Copy of the parameter values at session start (JSON); calculations in the session read this, never the live parameter_set.
columns.name: parameter_snapshot

columns.comment: When the meeting report was requested from the document service; null until the session is closed.
columns.name: report_requested_at

tables.name: movement_monthly
tables.comment: Monthly aggregate of goods_movement per client, sub-product, city, transport mode and direction; the input of every projection.

columns.comment: Quantity times unit price, summed over the month.
columns.name: value

tables.name: parameter_set
tables.comment: Admin parameters: one value per key and scope (product group, country, value), valid from a date.

columns.comment: Parameter key (ParameterKey enum in the backend).
columns.name: key

columns.comment: Free scope qualifier (city, sub-product) when the key is scoped that way.
columns.name: scope_value

tables.name: projection_by_dimension
tables.comment: Monthly projection per dimension value: city for Product 1, transport mode for Product 2 (dimension_kind says which).

columns.comment: CITY or TRANSPORT_MODE.
columns.name: dimension_kind

tables.name: projection_by_direction
tables.comment: Monthly projection per direction (IN, OUT).

tables.name: projection_by_subproduct
tables.comment: Monthly projection table per sub-product of the session (cumulative values over the horizon).

columns.comment: Value plus transport and handling costs for the month.
columns.name: landed_cost

columns.comment: Running total of value from the first month of the horizon.
columns.name: cumulative_value

tables.name: projection_summary
tables.comment: Monthly totals of the session projection with the cover ratio.

columns.comment: Covered value divided by total value for the month (0 to 1).
columns.name: cover_ratio

tables.name: session_client_config
tables.comment: Per-session choices of the client: projection horizon, price basis and cover preference.

columns.comment: Projection horizon in months (12 to 60).
columns.name: horizon_months

columns.comment: Port whose prices are the basis of the projection (VLD, NRL, CST, MRD).
columns.name: price_basis

columns.comment: NONE, PARTIAL or FULL cover wished by the client; drives the cover quote.
columns.name: cover_preference

tables.name: session_movement_input
tables.comment: Movements modelled by hand during a session (the movement modal); they replace the imported history for the months they cover.

tables.name: session_peer_simulation
tables.comment: Peer simulation requested in a session: the peer segment and the scaling factor applied to the projection of the client.

columns.comment: Factor applied to the quantities of the client to simulate a peer of the chosen segment.
columns.name: scaling_factor

tables.name: shedlock
tables.comment: ShedLock table: distributed locks of the scheduled jobs (one row per job name). Technical.

tables.name: stress_test_result
tables.comment: Stress test output per session, scenario, month and dimension value: exposure and cumulative exposure.

columns.comment: Value at risk for the month under the scenario.
columns.name: exposure

columns.comment: Change of transport cost for the month caused by the scenario.
columns.name: transport_cost_delta
